boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Stanford traditions, from graduation costumes to campus gatherings and performances.

cards.title: Join the Wacky Walk
cards.subtitle: Stanford Commencement at Stanford Stadium
cards.notes: If you are an eligible graduating senior, plan a costume or small themed group and follow the current Commencement lineup and safety instructions.
cards.short_summary: A costumed, irreverent student procession that opens Stanford’s Commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford describes Wacky Walk as a traditional irreverent procession of costumed graduates into Stanford Stadium.
cards.source_title: Stanford celebrates its largest graduating class ever at Commencement 2025
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors only; participation and permitted costume items are governed by current Commencement instructions.

cards.title: Mark Full Moon on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Main Quad, Stanford University
cards.notes: Look for the winter-quarter event details and participate only in its consent-centered format; roses are used as an expression of appreciation.
cards.short_summary: A reworked campus tradition centered on gratitude, roses, and affirmative consent.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Student Affairs says Full Moon on the Quad is now held in winter quarter and emphasizes gratitude and affirmative consent.
cards.access_notes: Follow current event guidance; people who appear intoxicated are not permitted to participate, according to Student Affairs.

cards.title: Catch the Band Run
cards.subtitle: Stanford campus, especially around Big Game
cards.notes: Check student and athletics announcements around Big Game, then watch from a safe public spot as the Leland Stanford Junior University Marching Band passes through.
cards.short_summary: A Stanford tradition tied to the marching band and campus celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford’s vice provost for student affairs is described as participating each year in the Band Run, identifying it as a Stanford tradition.
cards.source_title: Susie Brubaker-Cole will step down at the end of fall quarter
cards.access_notes: Routes and timing vary; use current university or band announcements and keep clear of performers and traffic.

cards.title: Look for a FLiCKS screening
cards.subtitle: Stanford campus Sunday-night movie tradition
cards.notes: Watch Stanford student-life announcements for the next Sunday-night campus movie, then attend according to the venue’s current entry and conduct rules.
cards.short_summary: A revived Sunday-night campus movie tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford reported that student-led efforts revived FLiCKS, the Sunday-night campus movie event.
cards.source_title: Student needs, impacts of new administration discussed at Faculty Senate
cards.access_notes: Screening location, programming, and access rules vary by event.

cards.title: Watch for Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Stanford campus, academic-year event
cards.notes: Check residential and student-life calendars during the quarter for the next Midnight Breakfast and confirm its location, timing, and attendance requirements.
cards.short_summary: A late-evening Stanford campus tradition named by the university president.
cards.evidence_claim: In 2026, Stanford President Jonathan Levin named Midnight Breakfast among traditions rebuilt by the Class of 2026.
cards.source_title: President Jonathan Levin addresses the Class of 2026
cards.access_notes: Event details and eligibility vary; rely on the current residential or Student Affairs listing.

cards.title: Find the Mausoleum Party listing
cards.subtitle: Stanford Mausoleum, 395 Campus Drive
cards.notes: If the annual Halloween gathering is scheduled, review the official event listing, bring required Stanford ID, and follow the stated costume and safety rules.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Stanford Halloween tradition held at the historic mausoleum.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Giving identifies the Mausoleum Party as one of its long-running campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: A 2024 official listing described a substance-free student event requiring an SUID; confirm current rules before attending.

cards.title: See Gaieties when it returns
cards.subtitle: Stanford campus performance tradition
cards.notes: Check the current student-event calendar for dates and venue, then attend the show using the organizer’s ticketing and accessibility information.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Stanford extracurricular tradition associated with student performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Giving lists Gaieties among the university’s long-running campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: Schedule, venue, tickets, and admission requirements vary by production.

cards.title: Plan for Senior Formal
cards.subtitle: Stanford University senior-class event
cards.notes: Eligible seniors can monitor class and Student Affairs announcements for the formal’s date, venue, registration process, and current guest policies.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Giving lists Senior Formal among the university’s long-running campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: Intended for the relevant senior class; registration, cost, and guest rules vary by year.

cards.title: Celebrate at Senior Dinner on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Main Quad with Memorial Church backdrop
cards.notes: Graduating undergraduates can follow the Alumni Association’s current instructions for this one-time class gathering, including event registration and arrival details.
cards.short_summary: A senior-class dinner and dance held beneath the stars during Commencement week.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Alumni Association describes Senior Dinner on the Quad as an event with dining, dancing, class time capsule activities, games, and the whole class in attendance.
cards.access_notes: Undergraduate students are allowed to attend this experience once, according to the Alumni Association; confirm current registration details.

cards.title: Take a final fountain hop
cards.subtitle: Terman Fountain and Stanford campus fountains
cards.notes: Use only permitted fountains and follow posted rules; check class or Alumni Association announcements for organized, supervised fountain-hop events.
cards.short_summary: A Stanford tradition of visiting campus fountains, including a senior-class final hop.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Alumni Association called its 2026 Senior Picnic at Terman Fountain a final fountain hop with the class.
cards.access_notes: Do not enter a fountain unless an official event or posted rules expressly permit it; organized-event details vary.
